### 1.  Positions of the three people  

*Al* stands on the walkway, so his speed relative to the ground equals the walkway speed  

\[
x_A(t)=6t\qquad (t\ge 0).
\]

*Bob* gets on the walkway \(2\) s after Al and walks on it at \(4\) ft/s relative to the walkway.  
Hence his ground speed while on the walkway is  

\[
6+4=10\text{ ft/s},
\]
and his position for \(t\ge2\) is  

\[
x_B(t)=10(t-2)\qquad (t\ge2).
\]

*Cy* reaches the start \(2\) s after Bob, i.e. at \(t=4\), and walks beside the walkway at \(8\) ft/s (ground speed).  
Thus for \(t\ge4\)

\[
x_C(t)=8(t-4)\qquad (t\ge4).
\]

All three are present only for \(t\ge4\).  (Bob stays on the walkway until \(t=12\) and Al until \(t\approx16.7\), well after the instant we will find.)

---

### 2.  “Half‑way’’ condition  

At the required instant one of the three is exactly halfway between the other two.  
We examine the three possibilities.

---

#### (i) Al is the middle person  

\[
x_A =\frac{x_B+x_C}{2}.
\]

Substituting the expressions:

\[
6t=\frac{10(t-2)+8(t-4)}{2}
      =\frac{10t-20+8t-32}{2}
      =\frac{18t-52}{2}=9t-26.
\]

Hence  

\[
6t = 9t-26\;\Longrightarrow\;3t = 26\;\Longrightarrow\;t=\frac{26}{3}\text{ s}.
\]

This time is larger than \(4\) s, so all three are present.  

Position of Al (the middle person) then is  

\[
x_A =6\Bigl(\frac{26}{3}\Bigr)=52\text{ ft}.
\]

Check the ordering:

\[
x_B=10\!\Bigl(\frac{26}{3}-2\Bigr)=\frac{200}{3}\approx66.7\text{ ft},
\qquad
x_C=8\!\Bigl(\frac{26}{3}-4\Bigr)=\frac{112}{3}\approx37.3\text{ ft},
\]

so \(x_B > x_A > x_C\); Al indeed lies exactly halfway between Bob and Cy.

---

#### (ii) Bob is the middle person  

\[
x_B =\frac{x_A+x_C}{2}
      \Longrightarrow 10(t-2)=\frac{6t+8(t-4)}{2}=7t-16.
\]

This gives \(3t=4\), i.e. \(t=\frac{4}{3}\) s, which is before Cy has even started moving (\(t\ge4\)).  
Thus this case is impossible.

---

#### (iii) Cy is the middle person  

\[
x_C =\frac{x_A+x_B}{2}
      \Longrightarrow 8(t-4)=\frac{6t+10(t-2)}{2}=8t-10,
\]

which simplifies to \(-32=-10\), a contradiction.  No solution exists.

---

Therefore the only feasible scenario is the one found in case (i).

---

feet from the start of the walkway.<|eot_id|> <|end_of_text|>
